channel.title: Devops on Junho Lee
channel.description: Recent content in Devops on Junho Lee

item.title: Handing Post-PR Work to Claude Code: /ship, /steward, and Approval Policies
item.description: How to hand CI failures, review comments, and merge conflicts to /code-review, /ship, and /steward, where to write down repeated review feedback, and how to trial a team approval policy in observe mode before enforcing it.

item.title: Reviewing Agent-Generated Code at Scale: Six Verification Layers on the Claude Code Team
item.description: How the Claude Code team—where Claude writes roughly 90% of the code—replaced line-by-line human gatekeeping with six automated verification layers, risk-based approval counts, convergence rules for agent review loops, and fast rollback.

item.title: macOS Sleep Prevention Compared: Built-in caffeinate vs Amphetamine
item.description: A practical comparison of macOS’s built-in caffeinate CLI and the Amphetamine menu bar app across flags, automation triggers, and closed-clamshell behavior.

item.title: 5 Practical Claude Code Plugins for Daily Development
item.description: Review five Claude Code plugins covering pre-coding design, UI implementation, multi-agent PR review, security auditing, and SQLite-backed session memory.

item.title: Comparing Three LLM Wiki Tools That Turn Source Code into Living Docs
item.description: Compare DeepWiki, Google Code Wiki, and OpenWiki across hosting model, repository support, security posture, and auto-sync workflows for code documentation.

item.title: Four Types of Agentic Loops in Claude Code: Triggers and Stopping Rules
item.description: Based on Anthropic’s guide, break down turn-based, goal-based, time-based, and proactive loops by trigger, stopping condition, verification, and token cost.

item.title: Designing an Autonomous QA Agent Loop Starting from Feature Inventory
item.description: Why Greg Brockman’s Codex QA loop starts with a canonical feature spreadsheet before testing and fixing bugs, and how to scope it safely in production.

item.title: Claude Code Harness: Explicit Spec and Review Guardrails for Coding Agents
item.description: Claude Code Harness enforces explicit specs, TDD work loops, and gated reviews for coding agents using a zero-Node.js Go guardrail engine.

item.title: Claude Autoresearch: Autonomous Metric-Driven Iteration in Claude Code
item.description: How Claude Autoresearch runs an 8-step modify-verify-rollback loop inside Claude Code to optimize single metrics like test coverage automatically.

item.title: OptimizerDuck: One-Screen Open-Source Windows Optimization
item.description: OptimizerDuck consolidates Windows telemetry disabling, bloatware removal, GPU registry tweaks, and restore-point rollbacks into one portable GUI.

item.title: Hermes Agent v0.14.0: A Practical Agent Runtime Guide
item.description: Nous Research’s Hermes Agent v0.14.0 unifies CLI and 22 messaging platforms with faster cold starts, local subscription proxies, and computer use.

item.title: Tuning Claude Code: Why Lean Setup and 3 Config Lines Beat Skill Bloat
item.description: Keeping Claude Code near stock, forcing full reasoning with three settings.json flags, and focusing on system architecture beats piling on third-party skills.

item.title: Streaming 1 Million Excel Rows in Spring Boot Without OOM via StreamSheet
item.description: StreamSheet exports 1 million rows to Excel in Spring Boot without OutOfMemoryErrors, replacing repetitive Apache POI streaming boilerplate with one annotation.

item.title: Serverless Daily Market Briefings with Python, GitHub Actions, and Telegram
item.description: Macro-Pulse automates daily equity, rate, and commodity tracking without a dedicated server using Python, GitHub Actions cron jobs, and Telegram alerts.
